keys.end: the TTM's period end (latest quarter or fiscal year)
keys.how: TTM construct per item: FY | FY+nQ (FY + n quarters - the same n a year earlier) | 4Q | FY~ (the latest quarter not chained)
keys.filed: [form, date] of the newest filing used
keys.t: TTM as filed: eps (diluted, USD/share), dps, rev, ni, oi, ebitda, da, ocf, capex, fcf, gp, int (USD)
keys.te: an item's own period end where it differs from end
keys.b: balance sheet at its latest date bd: eq (common = eqT - pref), eqT, pref, cash, sti, cashT (= cash + sti), debt (ltd + current + short-term + finance leases), ltd, dc, sd, opl / fil (operating / finance leases)
keys.mc: [market cap, 'sec' = price x the SEC share count | 'book']
keys.m: multiples at px from OUR denominators where the pick is ours: pe, ps, pb, ev, evs (EV/sales), eve (EV/EBITDA), evo (EV/EBIT), fcfy, ey, dy, roe, gm, om, nm, nde (net debt / EBITDA), ic (interest cover)
keys.y: Yahoo's figure, the gap and the band per field: [yahoo, ours/yahoo - 1, band(, the debt definition that matched)]; band agree | near | check | newer (ours is the later period) | older | only (Yahoo has none) | partial (debt / cash before the z204 re-read)
keys.use: per field: 'sec' | 'yahoo' | null (disputed - neither for decisions)
keys.rc: the revenue concept the TTM came from
keys.q: flags: split:<end>:x<k> (a per-share figure re-based) · basis? (share counts jump by no split factor) · eps>price · class? (another listing of the same filer - a share class, preferred or note) · no-cap (no market cap in the book) - these four: our per-share / revenue / book figures are used only where Yahoo agrees · neg-rev · stale (newest period > 15 months old) · fy-only (the latest quarter could not be chained)

method: as filed (SEC XBRL, USD): TTM = last FY + quarters since - the same quarters a year earlier (else 4 quarters); per-share figures re-based across splits by the weighted diluted counts; debt = non-current + current + short-term borrowings; total cash = cash + short-term investments; EV = market cap + debt - total cash; Yahoo checked on the same period (45 days)
